ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 1:5 of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity surface pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented surface with a vertical dark band extending from the median notch. Scattered high-intensity white micro-blobs (diameter < 5 pixels) are distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 70 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the central lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 8 pixels against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve meeting at a sharp central notch; the leading edge exhibits a smooth convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (diameters 3-10 pixels) distributed across the central and left-medial regions of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, dark-pigmented linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks across the left lobe surface; irregular, jagged pixel termination at the tip of the right lobe.
